target.title: fix(agents): honor abort signal during compaction summary retry backoff
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`summarizeChunks` in `src/agents/compaction.ts` retries summary generation via `retryAsync`. The mandatory `params.signal` is already forwarded to `generateSummary` and checked in `shouldRetry`, but the backoff sleep between attempts used the default unabortable timer. When a user cancels a session mid-compaction, the retry loop still waits out the full backoff (500ms–5s with jitter) before the abort is noticed.

## Why This Change Was Made

`retryAsync` accepts a custom `sleep`; this passes `sleepWithAbort(ms, params.signal)` (imported from `../infra/backoff.js`, the same source as `src/agents/api-key-rotation.ts`). An abort during the backoff now rejects the sleep, which propagates through `retryAsync` unwrapped — the existing `signal.aborted` checks in `summarizeChunks`/`summarizeWithFallbackResult` rethrow it, and the outermost compaction safeguard treats it exactly like the pre-existing abort path (cancel compaction, keep history). Only the response latency changes. This follows the same abort-aware-backoff pattern as the recently merged #109604 (telegram startup probe) and #108561 (discord gateway READY retry).

## Changes

- Pass `sleep: (ms) => sleepWithAbort(ms, params.signal)` to `retryAsync` in `summarizeChunks`.
- Add a regression test: `generateSummary` rejects once with a retryable error, the caller aborts 50ms into the ≥500ms backoff; asserts rejection with the abort reason, wall clock under 400ms, and exactly one `generateSummary` call.

## User Impact

Cancelling a session while compaction is retrying a summary now stops promptly instead of lingering through the remaining backoff.

## Evidence

Exact head: `fe96c958ae2800f35bdffae9eab907d21d04addf`.

**Outside-runner behavior proof** — the production `summarizeInStages` from `src/agents/compaction.ts` is driven directly (no test runner, no mocks) via `node --import tsx` against a real `node:http` loopback model endpoint. The endpoint returns HTTP 400, which the OpenAI SDK does not retry internally, so the only backoff in play is compaction's own `retryAsync` (real production schedule: `attempts: 3, minDelayMs: 500`). The abort fires 200ms after the first failure response is sent — deterministically inside the backoff. History preservation is verified by JSON-snapshotting the caller-owned messages array across the rejection.

After fix — abort mid-backoff rejects in 1ms with the abort reason, exactly one model request, history byte-identical:

```text
$ env -C .worktrees/compaction-retry-abort node --import tsx /tmp/compaction-abort-proof.mts; echo "exit=$?"
[proof] loopback model endpoint listening at http://127.0.0.1:46463
[provider-transport-fetch] [model-fetch] start provider=proof-local api=openai-completions model=proof-model method=POST url=http://127.0.0.1:46463/chat/completions timeoutMs=undefined proxy=none policy=custom
[proof-server] model request #1 POST /chat/completions at +281ms
[provider-transport-fetch] [model-fetch] response provider=proof-local api=openai-completions model=proof-model status=400 elapsedMs=101 contentType=application/json
[proof-server] AbortController.abort() fired at +485ms (inside retry backoff)
[proof] mode=after outcome=rejected(Error: aborted) abortAtMs=485 abortToRejectMs=1 elapsedMs=486 requests=1 historyPreserved=true verdict=PASS
exit=0
```

Before fix (same script with `src/agents/compaction.ts` from `upstream/main`, restored immediately after): the same abort is ignored until the ≥500ms backoff elapses — rejection arrives 328ms after the abort, and with the summarization-path error (`CompactionError: Request was aborted.`) instead of the abortable-sleep rejection.

```text
[proof] loopback model endpoint listening at http://127.0.0.1:39405
[proof-server] model request #1 POST /chat/completions at +256ms
[provider-transport-fetch] [model-fetch] response provider=proof-local api=openai-completions model=proof-model status=400 elapsedMs=89 contentType=application/json
[proof-server] AbortController.abort() fired at +459ms (inside retry backoff)
[proof] mode=before outcome=rejected(CompactionError: Request was aborted.) abortAtMs=459 abortToRejectMs=328 elapsedMs=787 requests=1 historyPreserved=true verdict=PASS
exit=1 (after-fix expectations unmet: abort-to-reject 328ms vs 1ms)
```

The discriminating evidence is abort-to-rejection latency (1ms vs 328ms) plus error identity (`Error: aborted` from the abortable sleep vs the error surfaced only after riding out the backoff); conversation history is preserved in both modes (`historyPreserved=true`).

Regression test:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/compaction.summarize-fallback.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  5 passed (5)
```

Same suite against the pre-change implementation (file at `upstream/main`): the new test fails — the abort is ignored, the loop sleeps through the ~500ms backoff and calls `generateSummary` a second time (1130ms, rejects with the summarization error instead of the abort reason).

`oxlint` clean on both changed files; `tsgo` core project reports no errors in compaction files.

## Intentionally out of scope

- No change to retry counts, delay bounds, or the transient-error classification in `shouldRetry`.
- No change to the compaction safeguard's cancel handling; abort already landed there via other paths.
